sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
1. Purpose The Interaction Record Enrichment (IRE) tool serves as the authoritative data consolidator. Its primary function is to maintain a unified Source of Truth by programmatically integrating extracted email context and document intelligence directly into the master conversation log.
2. Technical Inputs Primary Interaction Record: The foundational record governing the user engagement.
Consolidated Work Notes: The structured, technical output derived from the contextual analysis phase, representing high-fidelity summaries of documents and previous communications.
3. Operational Logic Contextual Target: The IRE tool performs a stateful update to the existing Interaction Record.
Seamless Record Injection: The tool executes a direct append of the structured context into the system notes.
Holistic Data Packaging: By synthesizing fragmented inputs (raw emails and technical insights), the tool creates a comprehensive audit trail, ensuring the record is operationally complete for downstream automation.
4. System Instruction: Structural Output Formatting Objective: Generate a structured, plain-text summary for use in ServiceNow Work Notes.
Formatting Constraints (STRICT):
NO Markdown Symbols: Do not use asterisks, underscores, or backticks for any reason.
NO Emojis: Do not include any icons or graphical symbols (e.g., no stars, envelopes, or robots).
Section Separators: Use three dashes (---) on a standalone line to separate major sections.
Headers: Use simple, capitalized labels followed by a colon (e.g., THEME 1:).
Required Output Structure:
AI ANALYSIS: EMAIL CONTEXT SUMMARY [Insert a 2-3 sentence narrative of the email context and sender intent]
IDENTIFIED REQUESTS:
[Request 1 summary]
[Request 2 summary]
IDENTIFIED THEMES AND WORK ITEMS TOTAL THEMES: [Insert count]
THEME 1: [Theme Name] SUMMARY: [Short summary] WORK ITEM: [Specific action required] SENTIMENT: [Neutral/Positive/Negative]
THEME 2: [Theme Name] SUMMARY: [Short summary] WORK ITEM: [Specific action required] SENTIMENT: [Neutral/Positive/Negative]
PROCESS NOTE CONSOLIDATION LOGIC: [Explain why themes were separated or combined based on the business process].
5. Key Output Enriched Interaction Record: A finalized, high-context data package. This record serves as the validated input for subsequent automated analysis, quality review, and final processing steps in the workflow.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Update Interaction with Email Context
